usedFor: Shopify abandoned checkouts get their phone number checked by 1Lookup.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Validate Phone Number” in 1Lookup
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout is the one trigger carrying a phone number, and 1Lookup recommends an action.

watchOut: A shopper who left only an email gives “Validate Phone Number” nothing to check.
